title: Field Report: UAS-02 recovered with the deputy present

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Fleet & Logistics
fields.summary: Recovered with the CCSO deputy present and the homeowner’s consent. Two arms broken; PL-05 intact. The swollen pack is bagged in sand and watched for 30 minutes. Greenhouse roof panels and a raised bed broken. No one hurt.

findings.notes: Greenhouse roof panels and a raised bed broken

actionsTaken: Gave the homeowner the Group contact and claim process
Aircraft and media handed to the ASO

instructorNote: Watch for the homeowner treated well and the evidence chain kept.

snapshot.title: Time Jump — 11:00 AM — UAS-02 Still Unresponsive

fields.narration: All teams: It is now 11:00 AM. The UAS-02 aircraft remains on private property in the Birch Hollow Range. The Calder County Sheriff's Office (CCSO) has dispatched a deputy to the site, but will not arrive for 90 minutes. The property owner has not granted recovery permission. Per HUOG-ERP Section 8.1, recovery may not begin without a CCSO deputy present. The Incident Commander (ops) must decide whether to wait for the deputy or initiate emergency recovery under HUOG-ERP Section 8.1, which permits recovery only if the site is secure and the risk to public safety is minimal.
